IS 9537 : Part 5 : 2000 Conduits for Electrical Installations - Part 5 : Pliable Conduits of Insulating MaterialICS 28.120.10ETD 14Reaffirmed 20201 ScopeThis clause of Part 1 is applicable except as follows:Addition:This Indian Standard (Part 5) specifies requirements for pliable non-flame propagating plain and corrugated conduits of insulating material. It does not include self-recovering or flexible conduits.This standard also applies to corrugated conduits with a smooth exterior surface.
